Four API gateways A, B, C, D are tested. Exactly one is certified.
A supports vision but not streaming.
B supports streaming and tools, but fails nonce preservation.
C supports vision, streaming, tools, and preserves nonce.
D supports none of the required capabilities.
A certified gateway must satisfy all four: vision, streaming, tools, nonce preservation.
Which single gateway is certified? Reply with only the letter.
